retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist, high-key portrait featuring an inverted subject orientation against a textured neutral background with centered bottom-aligned serif typography.
excludeWhen: busy or colorful backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, inverted portrait of a person with platinum hair and soft, glowing skin, set against a grainy, warm-beige backdrop. The composition is anchored by a small, centered serif title at the bottom edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Inverted subject orientation creates a sense of disorientation and intimacy.
Monochromatic warm palette unifies the skin tones, background, and clothing.
High-key lighting minimizes harsh shadows, emphasizing smooth textures.
Small typography scale emphasizes the vastness of the negative space.
coreInvariants: Centered, small-scale serif text at the bottom margin.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, oriented upside-down.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the centered text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top with the shoulders, follows the neck down to the face, and ends at the small text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left and right sides, utilizing a grainy texture to add depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan tones in the background and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Platinum/silver hair providing a cool-toned highlight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brown/black in the eyelashes and eyebrows for definition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value; a bright, airy feel with subtle tonal transitions.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallics

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface usage for maximum minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif look.
A more common alternative if Didone styles are unavailable.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a person with platinum hair, oriented upside-down (head at bottom, shoulders at top). Use soft, warm lighting and a textured beige background. Ensure the skin has a soft glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word of text in a small, elegant serif font, centered horizontally near the bottom edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the subject completely inverted (180 degrees)?
Is the text small and centered at the bottom?
Is the color palette restricted to warm neutrals and platinum?
Is the lighting soft with minimal hard shadows?

mustRedesign: Unique facial tattoos or identifying marks
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the inverted pose.
Ensure the text is legible despite its small size.
Verify the grain texture is uniform across the background.
Confirm the lighting feels ethereal rather than flat.
recipe.reuseFormula: Inverted Portrait + Warm Neutral Palette + Minimalist Serif Footer
